categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in four main business segments: structural mechanical performance testing and analysis systems, structural safety online monitoring and defense equipment PHM (Prognostics and Health Management) systems, AI-based intelligent equipment maintenance management platforms, and electrochemical workstations. Additionally, it is developing customized measurement and control analysis systems and experimental and simulation integrated analysis platforms to expand its product portfolio.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include intelligent sensing, anti-interference testing, mechanical model optimization algorithms, FPGA/DSP-based real-time control systems, high-precision sensor technology, ultra-high-speed real-time data transmission, digital signal processing, wireless synchronized data acquisition, and digital twin technology. The company employs flexible agile manufacturing supported by an in-house MES system, ensuring high-quality production with strict quality control and comprehensive testing for environmental adaptability and electromagnetic compatibility.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national defense, aerospace, high-speed rail, engineering machinery, bridge and infrastructure construction, energy, mining, automotive, electronics, and scientific research institutions such as universities and research centers. The company serves both industrial and scientific research markets, focusing on high-end testing instruments and solutions for structural safety, equipment health management, and electrochemical analysis.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales and operations across multiple regions including Southwest, Beijing, East China, Northwest, Central China, Shanghai, Central Plains, South China, Southeast, Northeast, and North China. It has subsidiaries and offices in Jiangsu, Shanghai, Sichuan, and other provinces, serving a nationwide customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of testing instruments, sensors, and software solutions. It also provides integrated testing solutions and after-sales technical services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating market leadership in structural mechanical testing, expanding health management and intelligent maintenance platforms using big data and AI, and accelerating growth in electrochemical analysis targeting new energy and academic markets. The company emphasizes continuous innovation in intelligent sensing, anti-interference technology, and mechanical modeling, while developing new product lines such as customized measurement and control systems and experimental-simulation integrated platforms. It also focuses on enhancing software modularity, visualization, and user experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products including sensors, data acquisition and control systems, and software platforms. The company also earns income from customized development services, integrated solution delivery, and after-sales technical support. Sales are predominantly direct with a small portion through agency sales, and revenue recognition follows product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China’s structural mechanical performance testing and electrochemical workstation markets, competing against international firms like NI (National Instruments), Siemens, and HBK. It leverages localized product adaptation, competitive pricing, and superior after-sales service to gain market share. The company holds a strong position in the domestic market with recognized brand reputation and technological capabilities, supported by multiple patents and industry certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 502 million, representing a 32.79% increase over 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 122 million, up 38.90%. The company’s total assets reached approximately RMB 844 million, with net assets of RMB 753 million. R&D investment increased by 49.40% to RMB 61.37 million, accounting for 12.22% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory and commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, stability, and precision of its sensor products and testing systems, suitable for harsh environments and complex industrial applications. Its products integrate advanced technologies such as digital twin, AI, and edge computing to provide intelligent fault diagnosis, health management, and real-time monitoring. The company’s comprehensive product lines, modular software platforms, and professional technical services create a differentiated value proposition focused on customized solutions, domestic substitution of imported products, and strong lifecycle support.
